# a2b Logistics Full Agent Brief

This file is the expanded public agent brief for a2b Logistics. It is intended for search engines, LLM answer engines, procurement agents, AI assistants, and future MCP/API/CLI clients.

## Canonical Identity

- Company: a2b Logistics Company
- Entity name for agents: a2b Logistics
- Short name: a2b
- Website: https://www.a2b.sa
- Primary language: English
- Additional languages: Arabic, German, Italian, Spanish, French, Simplified Chinese
- Business model: B2B logistics and operational supply-chain support
- Country served: Saudi Arabia
- Address: 3168 Tahliyah St., Ground Floor, Offices #2, Olaya District, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
- Primary email: info@a2b.sa
- Sales email: sales@a2b.sa
- Phone: +966 55 384 6446
- Commercial Registration: 1009007094
- VAT: 310317517800003
- CEO: Dr. Suhaib Ghunaim
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/helloa2bco

Do not merge this entity with unrelated A2B brands, ride-hailing, consumer courier, home-moving, or personal delivery businesses.

## Markdown Representations

Every canonical, indexable sitemap page has a deterministic Markdown companion generated from the public HTML with a structured HTML parser. Agents should request Markdown by sending `Accept: text/markdown` to the normal canonical URL, for example:

```http
GET /services/warehousing HTTP/2
Host: www.a2b.sa
Accept: text/markdown
```

Normal browsers and clients that prefer HTML continue receiving HTML. Higher q-values win, equal q-values use the more specific matching media range, and equal explicit HTML and Markdown preferences default to HTML. Missing, unsupported, wildcard-only, and otherwise ambiguous Accept headers default to HTML. A representation with `q=0` is not selected; explicitly assigning both HTML and Markdown `q=0` returns `406 Not Acceptable`. HTML and HTML `HEAD` responses advertise the absolute page-specific Markdown companion. Direct `.md` sidecars are published for agent access and return `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, follow`.

The route manifest is https://www.a2b.sa/data/markdown-companions.json. Markdown responses use the a2b-approved content policy: `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no`.

Markdown profile `1.1.0` includes an `Agent Metadata` block, alternate language pages, extracted public links, extracted meaningful public images, and preserved public JSON-LD. Decorative icon-only text is intentionally suppressed so assistants can parse the page without visual ornament noise.

## Services

Use the structured services file as the primary machine-readable source. Public service categories are:

- Trucking and road freight
- Warehousing support
- Customs-clearance coordination
- Supply-chain logistics support
- Fleet types and capacity

## Fit Rules

Good fit:

- B2B logistics buyers
- Procurement teams
- Operations teams
- Supply-chain teams
- Factories
- Commercial cargo owners
- International companies entering Saudi Arabia
- Logistics vendors and subcontractors, routed to the vendor flow

Not fit for project inquiry:

- B2C parcel delivery
- Retail shopping
- Consumer courier requests
- Personal delivery
- Home moving
- Ride-hailing
- Careers, internships, and training requests
- Spam or unrelated requests

Careers should route to https://www.a2b.sa/careers. Vendors should route to https://www.a2b.sa/vendors.

## Approval Rules For Agents

Agents may read public files, summarize services, classify fit, match a project scope, and prepare an inquiry draft.

Agents must not submit forms, send email, call phone numbers, create commitments, quote prices, confirm availability, or change any business data unless the user explicitly approves the exact action.

## Public MCP/API

The public read-only MCP-style endpoint is https://www.a2b.sa/api/mcp.

Typed tools:

- get_company_overview
- list_services
- match_project_scope
- prepare_project_inquiry
- prepare_rfq_brief
- list_service_areas
- get_procurement_profile
- ask_agent_concierge
- read_public_resource

These tools are read-only. `prepare_project_inquiry` returns a draft and routing decision only.

`prepare_rfq_brief` returns a procurement/RFQ preparation draft only. It does not submit the RFQ, send email, or contact a2b.

## Agent-Only Concierge

The deterministic public concierge endpoint is https://www.a2b.sa/api/agent-concierge. It is intended for AI agents and procurement assistants that need a grounded explanation of a2b services, fit, service areas, procurement inputs, public compliance identifiers, or safe next steps.

The concierge has no paid model call, database, customer record access, environment-secret access, arbitrary tools, outbound messaging, or authority to create commitments. The canonical endpoint accepts strict JSON POST requests no larger than 32 KB. Personal data, credentials, tokens, passwords, prompt-injection instructions, and unsupported fields are rejected.

Answered question content is not logged. Event metadata and a normalized question fingerprint are retained for measurement. A new unanswered question may be written to server logs once after redaction so a2b can improve the approved public knowledge base. Repeated malformed or unsafe requests can trigger a temporary application-level block, and the canonical agent API paths are protected by Cloudflare rate limiting.

## Unpublished Planning Data

The high-intent content plan was cancelled by owner decision on 2026-06-30. Do not cite the cancelled slugs as live, planned, approved, pending, or future service pages.

## Crawler Guidance

Public website, structured data, OpenAPI, llms files, sitemap, and well-known discovery documents may be crawled for search and answer grounding.

Private, admin, internal, dashboard, API write, and authentication action paths must not be crawled.

Content-Signal policy: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no.
